an3.85:1.1: 86 athakho aññataro bhikkhu yena bhagavā tenupasaṅkami upasaṅkamitvā bhagavantaṃ abhivādetvā ekamantaṃ nisīdi ekamantaṃ nisinno kho so bhikkhu bhagavantaṃ etadavoca
an3.85:2.2: kittāvatā nu kho bhante sekho hotīti.
an3.85:2.3: sikkhatīti kho bhikkhu tasmā sekhoti vuccati
an3.85:2.5: adhisīlampi sikkhati adhicittampi sikkhati adhipaññampi sikkhati
an3.85:2.6: sikkhatīti kho bhikkhu tasmā sekhoti vuccatīti.
